nodes.label: npm run frames (PNG to WebP)
nodes.rationale: WebP quality 75, alpha quality 60 (alpha drives size); budgets desktop <=6 MB, mobile <=2.5 MB.

nodes.label: Bottle Slots (#bottle-slot-hero, #bottle-slot-feature)
nodes.rationale: Slots reserve space so there is no layout shift; canvas animates between their measured positions.

nodes.label: 3D Scroll-Spinning Bottle Animation
nodes.rationale: Signature feature: bottle rotates 360 degrees (frames 1-120) while travelling from hero to feature slot, scrubbed by scroll. Canvas in document flow avoids fixed-to-static swap.

nodes.label: Photo at Rest, Render While Moving
nodes.norm_label: photo at rest, render while moving
nodes.rationale: Still photo shows at progress <=0.01 and >=0.99; canvas fades in while moving. Photo is LCP image aligned pixel-for-pixel with frame 1; swap ordering prevents background showing through.

nodes.label: Certificates (FSSAI, Agmark, ISO 22000)
nodes.rationale: Do not reuse certificates from neeram.vercel.app/about; they belong to other companies.

nodes.label: Blender Frame Rendering (Phase 0)
nodes.rationale: Shadow_Catcher hidden because a baked floor shadow looks wrong on a moving bottle; a CSS shadow is used instead.

nodes.label: POST /api/checkout
nodes.rationale: Re-prices cart server-side from products.ts; falls back to mock payment when keys missing or any price is null.

nodes.label: src/lib/store-json.ts (JSONL storage)
nodes.rationale: Appends to data/*.jsonl locally; Vercel filesystem is read-only so it only logs there.
